title: FolderStructure
description: How a project's source tree is laid out. Each property is a folder in the source tree, named in its description, and its value is what lives there

Client.description: Inbound CLI entrypoints and argument handling, under src/client

Adapters.description: Outbound adapters implementing domain interfaces and translating external API shapes via Zod codecs, under src/adapters

Domain.description: Domain contracts, domain interfaces, and pure domain logic, under src/domain

IntegrationTest.description: Black-box integration tests exercising the shipped runtime artifact through its public interface, under src/integration-test

Clients.description: Generated external API clients and wire schemas, under clients
